name: Mojibake
essence: The catalog stores replacement text after incompatible writer and reader encodings.

examples.summary: The catalog stores replacement text after incompatible writer and reader encodings.
examples.mechanism: The producer writes latin-1 bytes while the consumer assumes the UTF-8 contract, replacing an invalid byte before persisting the decoded string.

ingredients.suggests: A producer and consumer exchange catalog bytes through one temporary file.
The writer and reader use incompatible encoding contracts.
